Pocket Advisor Architecture Overview

The system follows a microservice pipeline architecture:

Ingestion Path:
  Upload -> Discovery -> Extraction -> Chunking -> Embedding -> Indexing
  (RustFS)  (NATS)     (Workers)    (Workers)   (Workers)   (Postgres)

Retrieval Path:
  Query -> Decompose -> Embed -> Dense Search -> Lexical Search -> Fuse
       -> Pool -> Rerank -> Select -> Expand -> Budget -> Return

Key components:

1. NATS JetStream provides durable message queuing between ingestion
   stages. Each workspace has its own streams for isolation.

2. PostgreSQL with pgvector handles both lineage (Tier 2) and vector/
   lexical indexes (Tier 3). HNSW indexes enable fast approximate
   nearest neighbor search.

3. RustFS serves as the authoritative document store (Tier 1).
   Content-addressed objects ensure deduplication.

4. Model endpoints provide embedding, reranking, and query preparation
   (decomposition) capabilities. These are local, OpenAI-compatible APIs.

The system is deployed as a single Go binary on the host, with shared
stores running in a local Kubernetes cluster (OrbStack).

Configuration is split between:
- config.yaml: infrastructure endpoints and model settings
- workspace-config.yaml: collections and paths (gitignored)
- pocket-advisor-infra.yaml: credentials (gitignored)
